$\displaystyle\sum_{a\in A\cap[2^m,2^{m+1})}\frac1a\le2^{-m}r_k(2^m)$\\
$\displaystyle\le C_ke^{-c_k(m\log2)^{\varepsilon_k}}\quad(m\ge1)$};
